title: DevOps Engineer | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: DevOps Engineer. Category: Development. Duration: 9 months. Description: Designed for beginners and non-technical students who want to start a career in IT and Cloud Computing. Covers Linux, Web Development basics, Git & GitHub, AWS Cloud, Docker, Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible, Monitoring, and DevOps automation tools through practical hands-on projects. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
